ordered_diagnoses: Squamous Cell Carcinoma with Basaloid Features
shortlist: Squamous Cell Carcinoma with Basaloid Features

selector.runner_up: Squamous Cell Carcinoma with Basaloid Features
selector.rationale: The biopsy showed lobules and detached aggregates of eosinophilic keratinocytes with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli infiltrating the reticular dermis, which is consistent with invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. Although there are features typical of basal cell carcinoma, the primary diagnosis is supported by the biopsy results.

rejected.label: Basal Cell Carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of clear evidence of basaloid nests in the initial biopsy

rejected.label: Metastatic Squamous Cell Carcinoma
rejected.why: No clear evidence of metastasis in the provided vignette

rejected.label: Pseudocarcinomatous Hyperplasia
rejected.why: Contradicted by the diagnosis of invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
